tokens.name: burgundy
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour. Primary buttons, active nav, brand text and headlines' accent words, offer stamps, focus ring. Ivory text on it is 10:1.

tokens.name: burgundy-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed/hover state of burgundy fills; announcement bar, dark campaign bands, footer. Ivory text 13:1, soft gold text 8:1.

tokens.name: burgundy-soft
tokens.usage: Lighter burgundy for illustration, fabric tones in banners and the hover of burgundy on dark bands. Ivory text 7.4:1. Never as body text colour.

tokens.name: burgundy-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for the 'مفضل للمدارس' badge, selected radio cards and school-package panels. Burgundy text on it 9.3:1.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Muted gold ACCENT only: ornament rules, the thin frame inside offer stamps, icons on dark grounds, star ratings. Fails as text on light grounds (2.2:1) — never use it for text on cream/ivory/white. On burgundy it is 4.7:1 (text OK).

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Gold for text and lines on dark grounds (burgundy 6.2:1, burgundy-deep 8.1:1, charcoal 8.9:1): eyebrows and prices on campaign banners, the 'لفترة محدودة' badge label.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold-family TEXT on light grounds (ivory 5.6:1, gold-tint 5.3:1): eyebrows, the 'الأكثر طلباً' badge label.

tokens.name: gold-tint
tokens.usage: Warm gold-tinted ground: 'الأكثر طلباً' badge, secondary button, offer-condition panels.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Default page background. Everything sits on cream unless a section needs separation.

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Alternate section background (every other homepage band), card bodies on cream, text on dark fills.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Input fields, product cards that need lift on ivory, cut-out product photography grounds.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Photo backdrop / media placeholder behind product images; quiet band behind trust strips.

tokens.name: brown
tokens.usage: Warm dark neutral: default body text on cream/ivory/white (12:1+), wood and floor tones in imagery.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Strongest ink: headings, product titles, prices, the 'جديد' badge fill. 15:1 on cream.

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Headings, product names, prices — on cream, ivory, white, sand.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy, descriptions, form values — on cream, ivory, white, sand.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: helper text, captions, category labels, old (struck) prices — on cream 5.6:1, ivory 5.3:1, white 5.9:1, sand 4.8:1, gold-tint 4.9:1. Refined from #7A6E67, which fell to 4.4:1 on ivory.

tokens.name: text-brand
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured text: links, text buttons, active category, accent word in a headline — on any light ground.

tokens.name: text-on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on burgundy, burgundy-deep, charcoal, brown and photo scrims.

tokens.name: text-on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on burgundy (7:1) and burgundy-deep (9.3:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card dividers, section rules, table rows, header bottom edge. Decorative only — not for control edges.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger dividers: summary boxes, gallery thumbnails at rest, chip outlines on ivory.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects, quantity steppers, checkboxes and radio cards (3.9:1 on white, 3.4:1 on ivory — meets the 3:1 control floor).

tokens.name: border-on-dark
tokens.usage: Hairlines on burgundy and charcoal bands.

tokens.name: price
tokens.usage: Regular price figure.

tokens.name: price-offer
tokens.usage: Promotional price, 'عرض' badge fill and savings text. A brighter crimson than burgundy so offers read as offers — 6.6:1 on ivory, ivory text on it 6.6:1.

tokens.name: price-offer-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the 'وفّر' savings chip; price-offer text on it 6.4:1.

tokens.name: whatsapp
tokens.usage: The WhatsApp CTA fill ONLY (white label 5.4:1). Darker than WhatsApp's own #25D366 so white text passes. Never used for anything that does not open WhatsApp.

tokens.name: whatsapp-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed WhatsApp CTA.

tokens.name: whatsapp-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the WhatsApp conversion panel; whatsapp text on it 4.7:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text/icons: 'تم رفع الشعار', 'متوفر'. Always paired with a check icon.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Success message ground.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text: 'الكمية محدودة', production-time notices. Paired with an icon.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Warning message ground.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Form errors: message text, invalid input border. Always with an icon and words, never colour alone.

tokens.name: error-tint
tokens.usage: Error message ground.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral info notes (delivery, production time).

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Info note ground.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with a 2px cream gap (see shadow focus). On dark bands use gold-soft.

tokens.name: disabled-bg
tokens.usage: Disabled control fill.

tokens.name: disabled-text
tokens.usage: Disabled control label (exempt from contrast minimum, never used for live text).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Photo scrim behind text on campaign cards and heroes (bottom 60% only).

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Seasonal hero headline. Mobile 44px. Max 2 lines, 3–6 words. Class .rs-display-hero.

styles.name: display-campaign
styles.usage: Campaign names and full-width promotional banners. Mobile 34px. Class .rs-display-campaign.

styles.name: display-section
styles.usage: Major homepage section titles (العروض الحالية، باقات المدارس). Mobile 28px. Class .rs-display-section.

styles.name: display-figure
styles.usage: Offer figures inside banners and stamps: 1+1، 2+1، ‎-30%. Mobile 64px. Class .rs-display-figure.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles (category page, product name on PDP). Mobile 26px. Class .rs-h1.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Sub-section titles inside pages, form section titles. Mobile 22px. Class .rs-h2.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card group titles, bundle names, drawer titles. Mobile 18px. Class .rs-h3.

styles.name: product-title
styles.usage: Product names on cards (2 lines max, clamp). Mobile 15px. Class .rs-product-title.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Regular price. Mobile 18px. Western digits, currency 'د.أ' after the number at 0.7em. Class .rs-price__now.

styles.name: price-offer
styles.usage: Promotional price in price-offer colour. Mobile 20px. Class .rs-price__now--offer.

styles.name: price-was
styles.usage: Struck-through original price in text-muted. Mobile 14px. Class .rs-price__was.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs, hero sub-copy, About text. Mobile 16px. Class .rs-body-lg.
styles.sample: هدايا وتكريمات مخصّصة بالاسم والشعار، مصنوعة بعناية لكل مناسبة.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy, product descriptions, form values (16px stops iOS zoom). Class .rs-body.
styles.sample: نحفر الاسم وشعار المدرسة على لوحة ذهبية بتشطيب ناعم.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Helper text, card notes, footer links. Class .rs-small.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Image captions, legal lines, counters. Class .rs-caption.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels (md/lg). Small buttons 14px. Class .rs-btn.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, filter names, tab labels. Class .rs-label.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Header category links. Class .rs-nav__link.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Badges and tags. Never letter-space Arabic. Class .rs-badge.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small line above a display title (occasion, season) in text-brand or gold-ink, with a 24px gold rule. Class .rs-eyebrow.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudge, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between badges, icon + label in buttons, price row gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Product grid gap on mobile; card body padding top; chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; input horizontal padding; card internal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Field-to-field gap in forms.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Product grid gap on desktop; padding in bundle/offer cards; section header to content on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; section header to content on desktop; hero content padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space between product rows and an in-between banner (mobile).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero content padding on desktop; between banner and grid on desktop.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Homepage section vertical padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Homepage section vertical padding on tablet.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Homepage section vertical padding on desktop; whitespace around full-width campaign banners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, chips, small tags, thumbnails under 64px.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, quantity stepper, offer stamps, radio cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Product media, product/bundle/offer cards, gallery main image, upload zone.

tokens.name: radius-banner
tokens.usage: Heroes, full-width campaign banners, in-between banners, campaign cards, the WhatsApp section panel (desktop; 16px on mobile).

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Only for circles: category rail thumbnails, carousel arrows, the WhatsApp floating button, dots. Never for buttons or cards.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Inputs at rest, chips, quantity stepper.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest that sit on ivory; sticky header once scrolled.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Card hover lift (with a -2px translate), dropdown menus, offer stamp on photos.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Mobile drawer, sticky order bar, WhatsApp floating button, modals.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on light grounds: cream gap + 2px solid burgundy.

tokens.name: shadow-focus-dark
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on burgundy/charcoal bands.

layout.note: Breakpoints: sm 640px, md 768px, lg 1024px, xl 1280px. Mobile-first: write the mobile value, override upward.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width (product grids, banners). Banners may bleed to 1440px.

tokens.name: container-narrow
tokens.usage: Text pages, product customization form column, About copy.

tokens.name: gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Side padding under 768px.

tokens.name: gutter-desktop
tokens.usage: Side padding from 1024px.

tokens.name: header-mobile
tokens.usage: Mobile header bar height (plus the 52px category chip row). Logo 44px tall.

tokens.name: header-desktop
tokens.usage: Desktop two-tier header: 96px logo row + 52px category row.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for any control.
